remarks: Freshly Updated & Move-In Ready! Welcome to this bright and spacious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse in a convenient Downtown Stamford location. Recently updated with fresh improvements throughout, this home offers a clean, refreshed feel and is ready for its next tenant. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances and granite countertops, while the open dining and living area includes a cozy fireplace and sliding glass doors leading to a private balcony. A half bath is conveniently located on the main level. Upstairs, you'll find a spacious primary bedroom with a walk-in closet, a second bedroom, and an in-unit washer and dryer. Hardwood floors throughout, plus an attached garage. Conveniently located near Downtown Stamford, shopping, restaurants, Metro-North, and I-95. Available immediately - come see the fresh updates and make this your new home! Tenants must cover at least 50% of the first-floor area with padded carpet or area rugs. Carpet padding is required under all wall-to-wall carpeting.
